jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: About Lio Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises. Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale. At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies. Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI. We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact. The Role We're looking for a Product Manager – Pre-Sales & Go-to-Market who can bridge the gap between what enterprise customers need, what our engineers build, and how we bring our products to market. At Lio, product decisions don't happen in isolation. Every customer conversation, sales cycle, and implementation reveals new opportunities to make our AI agents more valuable. Your mission is to turn those insights into action. You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue. You'll be deeply involved in enterprise sales cycles, helping our teams communicate the value of our AI agents, build compelling business cases, and win customers. This isn't traditional Product Management. Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't manage a backlog or spend your time writing detailed specifications. Instead, you'll provide the customer context, commercial insights, and clear recommendations that help our engineers build the right things and our Sales team sell them effectively. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich - vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In unter zwei Jahren und mit weniger als 25 Leuten im HQ sind wir bereits Deutschlands zweitgrößter Immobilienverwalter geworden. Über die Rolle Ab Tag eins liegt die Geschäftsführung und operative Gesamtverantwortung für eine Hausverwaltung am Standort Remscheid in deinen Händen. Der Hauptfokus liegt dabei auf der Führung des Teams vor Ort, der kontinuierlichen Optimierung operativer Abläufe sowie der aktiven Mitgestaltung des Tagesgeschäfts. Als erfahrene Führungskraft repräsentierst du das Unternehmen gegenüber Kunden und garantierst eine erstklassige Verwaltungsqualität. Gemeinsam mit uns sicherst du nachhaltigen Erfolg und setzt neue Standards in der Branche. Deine Aufgaben Geschäftsführung einer Hausverwaltung und Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft der Niederlassung in Remscheid inklusive Budget-, Kosten- und GuV-Verantwortung sowie Qualitätssicherung. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. jobs.title: Global Investigator - Triage (APAC)
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defence in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close. The impact you will have: Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline. Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream. Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations. Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline. What we’re looking for: Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise. Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong. Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills. jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly. As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belan

jobs.title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
jobs.description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert, deren digitale DNA. Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in Automotive, Handel, Banken & Versicherungen sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor. Wir begrüßen Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, die sich bereits mit modernen KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools und generativer KI beschäftigen oder Interesse daran haben, diese sinnvoll in ihren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren. Den reflektierten Einsatz von KI sehen wir als wertvolle Ergänzung zu technischem Know-how und eigenständigem Denken. Als Senior Data Scientist verantwortest du datenwissenschaftliche Lösungen bei unseren Kund:innen end-to-end: von der Bewertung des Use Cases über Modellentwicklung und Validierung bis zur Produktivsetzung. Du bist die fachliche Ansprechperson für Statistik, Machine Learning und den praxisnahen Einsatz generativer KI, übersetzt Geschäftsfragen in analytische Lösungsansätze, berätst Stakeholder auf Augenhöhe und gibst dein Wissen im Team weiter. Gestaltung und fachliche Leitung von Data-Science- und KI-Projekten in interdisziplinären Teams – von der Problemdefinition bis zum produktiven Einsatz Identifikation und Bewertung von Use Cases hinsichtlich Machbarkeit, Datenlage und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Übersetzung von Geschäftsfragestellungen in analytische und technische Lösungsansätze Explorative Datenanalyse, Feature Engineering und Aufbereitung komplexer, heterogener Datensätze als Grundlage für Modellierung Entwicklung, Training und Optimierung statistischer und Machine-Learning-Modelle – etwa Regressions- und Klassifikationsverfahren, baumbasierte und Bayes'sche Methoden, Clustering, For

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.description: Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle gestaltest du CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji: Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung . Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows. Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen. Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. jobs.description: SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app. We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto. Join us! Are you an Accountant with a strong technical foundation, ideally shaped in a Big 4 audit or accounting outsourcing team, looking for broad, hands-on responsibility in an international group? SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. Our accounting team is small, and every member makes a real difference. In this role, you will own Accounts Payable and contribute across the full scope of the accounting function: month-end close, reconciliations, intercompany, VAT and tax, and audit preparation. We would love to hear from you if you are a versatile all-rounder who enjoys the variety that comes with a multi-entity group. The ideal candidate can step into any part of the accounting cycle, from processing supplier invoices to preparing audit files. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
jobs.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen. jobs.title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your Role As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection. You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. What you ll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You ll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
